description: Handpoint agent skills — task-focused integration guides for AI agents building with the Handpoint payment APIs and SDKs.
agent_instructions: Start by loading the entrypoint skill (handpoint.md). It will instruct you to ask the user for their acquirer and integration path, then load the two matching skills. Do not write any integration code before collecting this information and loading the appropriate skills. Load optional skills only when the user's task explicitly requires that operation.

workflow.step_1: Load handpoint.md — it contains instructions on what to ask the user
workflow.step_2: Ask the user: which acquirer? (EPI / EmerchantPay / Paystrax / PAYSAFE)
workflow.step_3: Ask the user: which integration path? (Cloud API / Android PAX / Android HiLite / iOS HiLite / Cordova)
workflow.step_5: Load optional skills only when the user's task requires that specific operation

entrypoint.title: Handpoint — start here
entrypoint.description: Entry point for all Handpoint integrations. Instructs the agent to ask the user for acquirer and integration path before loading the matching skills. Load this first.

acquirers.title: EPI — acquirer skill
acquirers.description: All EPI capabilities and constraints: mandatory batch close, post-sale tip adjustment, partial reversal, remote sale with AVS, pre-authorization, tokenization, and known error codes (ERR 005, 0601).

acquirers.title: EmerchantPay — acquirer skill
acquirers.description: All EmerchantPay capabilities: tipAmount in sale, automatic settlement, AMEX MID requirement, remote sale, pre-authorization, money remittance, tokenization.

acquirers.title: Paystrax — acquirer skill
acquirers.description: All Paystrax capabilities: tipAmount in sale, automatic settlement, AMEX MID requirement, remote sale, pre-authorization, tokenization. Same protocol as EmerchantPay.

acquirers.title: PAYSAFE — acquirer skill
acquirers.description: PAYSAFE capabilities and critical constraints: Interac VOID-only rule, no remote sale, no pre-auth, no partial reversal, Paysafe single-use tokenization, Paysafe Portal CNP refund flow.

paths.title: Cloud API (REST) — path skill
paths.description: Complete REST API integration: authentication, sale, refund, reversal, pre-auth, tip adjustment, batch close, polling, UNDEFINED handling, all endpoint reference.

paths.title: Android SDK — PAX on-device path skill
paths.description: Full Android SDK integration for apps running on PAX terminals: Gradle setup, initialization, sale, refund, reversal, pre-auth, tip adjustment, batch close, remote sale.

paths.title: Android SDK — HiLite Bluetooth path skill
paths.description: Full Android SDK integration for apps paired with HiLite Bluetooth readers: BT setup, device discovery, connection lifecycle, all supported operations.

paths.title: iOS SDK — HiLite Bluetooth path skill
paths.description: Full iOS SDK integration for iPhone/iPad apps paired with HiLite Bluetooth readers: Swift setup, delegate methods, all supported operations.

paths.title: Cordova / Ionic plugin — path skill
paths.description: Full Cordova/Ionic plugin integration: installation, initialization, all operations via JavaScript API, event listeners for results.

paths.title: eCommerce (SmartBoard) — online CNP payments path skill
paths.description: SmartBoard Card-Not-Present gateway for EU merchants. merchantID + merchantSecret credentials (separate system from card-present). HPP, HPF, Direct, Batch paths. 3DS mandatory for ECOM. Europe only (EEA, UK, Monaco).

optional.title: Back-office operations — remote sale, tokenization, tip adjustment, batch close
optional.description: Load when the task involves remote sale (card token or on-terminal), back-office refund, tokenization, tip adjustment, or batch close via REST API without a terminal.

optional.title: Transaction Feed API — recovery, reconciliation, reporting
optional.description: Load when the task involves UNDEFINED transaction recovery, reconciliation, transaction history queries, or the Transaction Feed API.

optional.title: Integration prerequisites — credentials, hardware, merchant setup
optional.description: Load when the user asks how to get set up for testing, what credentials are needed, what hardware to use, or how a test merchant is created. Covers all integration paths with the Handpoint Support / ISV responsibility split.

optional.title: Integration compliance checklist — receipt, logging, recovery, reconciliation
optional.description: Load when reviewing an integration for certification readiness. Covers EMV receipt field requirements, logging retention policy, per-merchant API key management, page-refresh crash recovery code pattern, partial approval /status timing trap, and a reconciliation utility.
